About the Artist

Art with a soul,
made by hand.

Every piece that leaves this studio carries something real — a mood, a memory, a moment. I'm Mona, and based in Surat, I create original artworks and custom commissions, blending traditional techniques with a contemporary visual language. Whether it is a portrait for someone you love or an original piece for your space, the work is made thoughtfully, from start to finish.

How it Works

Commission Process

I
Share Your Vision

Tell me what you have in mind — references, mood, size, medium, and the story behind it. No idea is too vague.

II
Quote & Confirm

Receive a transparent quote based on your brief. A 50% advance confirms the commission slot.

III
Creation & Review

I work on your piece and share progress updates. Up to two revision rounds are included.

IV
Delivery

Final piece is delivered digitally in high-resolution, or physically via courier — carefully packed.
